senses.gloss:
रुद् रुद्, ii. 2, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., Rām. 2, 52, 19, and i. 1, Chr. 24, 46).
 1. To weep, Vikr. 83, 12; Hit. 99, 3 (read रुदती); to cry, MBh. 2, 2616.
 2. To bewail, Bhaṭṭ. 5, 5.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. रुदित.
 1. Wept.
 2. Weeping. n. Weeping, Daśak. in Chr. 184, 10.
 --Comp.
 --Frequent. रोरुद्, रोरुद्य, To weep, to cry [] excessively, MBh. 3, 10192.
 --Caus. रोदय, To cause to weep, Utt. Rāmac. 85, 3.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु, To weep, Nal. 3, 32.
 --With उपा उप-आ, To bewail, Bhaṭṭ. 2, 4.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To burst into tears, MBh. 3, 2919.
 2. To weep, to cry, Rām. 1, 17, 22. प्र-रुदित,
 1. Wept.
 2. Weeping, Brāhmaṇav. 3, 21.
 3. Beginning to weep, Vikr. d. 153.
 --With वि वि, To weep, Bhāg. P. 3, 17, 13. विरुदित, n. Weeping, Utt. Rāmac. 73, 11.
 --Cf. Lat. rudere; O.H.G. riuzan; A.S. reotan; probably ὀῤῥωδέω (frequent., cf. रौद्र).

रुद्र रुद् + र,
 I. adj. One who roars, Chr. 290, 3 = Rigv. i. 64, 3.
 II. m.
 1. A name of Śiva as the god of the tempests, Pañc. pr. d. 1; Bhartṛ. 2, 93.
 2. A class of eleven demigods (personified roaring of the wind), Nal. 10, 24.
 III. f. रुद्राणी, Durgā. Pāṇ. iv. 1, 49.
 IV. f. द्री, A sort of lute.
 --Cf. perhaps λύρα.
रुद्र- + सावर्णि रुद्र- + सावर्णि, m. the twelfth Manu, ib. 28.
